address: Château de Chilly, 42 route du Crépy, Douvaine, 74140, France
bio: The epitome of rural France! With its exposed stonework, beams, floorboards and fireplace, so welcome during cold winter evenings, this authentic little 15C castle will delight those of a romantic disposition, as will the mystery menu of chef Jérôme Mamet, who is a stickler when it comes to plating! This inventive and talented chef works only with carefully selected, often organic, ingredients of the highest quality. Delicious terrace....
